name: badge

frames.best_why: Both rows of variants are fully visible and evenly lit with no cursor overlapping any pill.

tagline: Small rounded pills label status, counts and categories in a row.
summary: A set of compact pill labels in four fills, plus outlined versions carrying a tick, a coloured dot, a number or a link. Each is a single line of small medium-weight text on a full rounded background or border.
appearance: Two rows of short pills on a black stage. The top row runs from a light filled pill through a dark grey and a bordered clear one to a pink-red one; the second row mixes outlined pills with a green tick, an amber dot, a white counter pill and a dark link pill.
behaviour: Static: the clip only shows the pills sitting still. In the code a linked pill darkens slightly on hover, and keyboard focus adds a soft ring.
demo_content: Labels Default, Secondary, Outline, Destructive, Verified, Pending, a count of 12 and Link badge.
search_phrases: small pill label for a status
count bubble next to a title
tag showing verified with a tick
tiny rounded tag in a list
use_when: You need a compact inline label for status, counts or categories inside text or a list.
avoid_when: Labels are kept on one line with no wrapping, so a long tag will overflow instead of growing taller.
customise: The label is passed as children, the variant prop picks default, secondary, outline or destructive, and className overrides any style; asChild swaps the span for a link.
weight_why: A span with background and border classes; nothing runs or animates.

a11y.note: The pill is presentational text with no role; only the linked variant is focusable, and then it shows a visible ring.

issues: The secondary and outline variants are so close in darkness that they are hard to tell apart
No frame shows the hover or focus states the code defines
polish_why: Seven tidy variants in a clear grid; the dark variants barely separate from the background.
